summary: CVR Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a 10,515,248-share common stock offering priced at $47.55 per share, raising roughly $500 million ($490 million net before expenses), with a 1,577,287-share greenshoe. Proceeds, plus cash and other financing, fund an unspecified Acquisition, redemption of the 2028 Notes, and fees. The offering is not contingent on the acquisition closing; absent a deal, proceeds go to general corporate purposes. Barclays and Jefferies are joint book-running managers. Watch acquisition terms and financing closing risk.
